messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['Since you have chosen not to renew the domain name listed below during the applicable grace period, we were successful in securing a back order for this domain name on your behalf, and it has been transferred to another party in accordance with the Service Agreement.', 'We have recently determined that different computers connected to your account Verified by Visa, Password and multiple failures were present before the connection.', 'Your account is suspended due to Halifax Plc major Terms are being changed.', 'We recently have determined that different computers have logged onto your Online Banking account, and multiple password failures were present before the logons.', 'YOUR APPLE iTunes ACCOUNT HAS BEEN LIMITED', 'Your Internet Banking Password was entered incorrectly 3 times.  For the protection of your account we have suspended access to it.', 'I later discovered that He passed on in February 2004.', 'We would like to inform you that we have released a new version of NatWest Customer Form.', 'To ensure your protection, we have now blocked access to your accounts due to a system error (error code : 0491e8).', 'Congratulations! You won a 10,000 miles British Airways gift card.', 'We recently have determined that different computers have logged in your Alliance-Leicester Online Banking account, and multiple password failures were present before the logons.', 'Hence, your access to use this service has been limited.', 'We have today introduced a new security service which will protect customers from such attacks.', 'We thought you must be informed that our shop shipped your item, and that this completes your order.', 'We are running a scheduled maintenance on our servers.', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "We provide updates about account security, access restrictions, service changes, maintenance, orders, and other important events affecting your account."}
